subject: Object-view
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1019a). "This reference of identifier-1 is treated at compile-time as though it had the description specified by the AS phrase" (OK 1)). The view binds to a compiler temporary DESCRIBED by the phrase (DataBinder.OoCreateObjectViewTemp, PicInfo.ObjectReferenceItem(view)), filled by the BoundObjectView pre-op and read as a BoundNumRef, so every rule that asks an object reference's description (SET SR10-SR14, INVOKE roster selection, inline SR2) asks the view's: `SET OA TO OU AS PB1425VA` narrows a universal into a typed receiver, `INVOKE OU AS PB1425VD "SPEAK"` resolves statically, `OU AS UNIVERSAL` takes the dynamic path. [editions: the OO facility, 2002+]
